theory.title: Exercise 2.4.2: IN RANGE Iteration
theory.content:
🔢 Numeric Iteration

MENTOR-9: "Lists are great, but sometimes you just need NUMBERS. Count up, count down, skip by twos..."

"That's where IN RANGE shines. No list needed - just start, stop, and step!"

📘 IN RANGE Syntax

Three Forms:

# 1. Single argument (0 to N, exclusive)
FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    5
    # Iterates: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
END

# 2. Start and stop (start to stop, exclusive)
FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    1    6
    # Iterates: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
END

# 3. Start, stop, step (with custom increment)
FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    5    0    -1
    # Iterates: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 (countdown!)
END

💡 Common Patterns

# Countdown timer
FOR    ${count}    IN RANGE    10    0    -1
    Log    ${count}...
END
Log    Blastoff!

# Count by twos
FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    0    10    2
    Log    Even number: ${i}    # 0, 2, 4, 6, 8
END

# Simple 1-10 loop
FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    1    11
    Log    Item ${i}    # 1, 2, 3... 10
END

⚙️ Key Rules

  • 🔹 Stop is EXCLUSIVE: RANGE 1 5 → 1,2,3,4 (not 5)
  • 🔹 Default step is 1: RANGE 0 5 → 0,1,2,3,4
  • 🔹 Negative step: Counts down (start > stop)
  • 🔹 Zero iterations: RANGE 5 5 → empty (no loop)

🎯 Your Task

Create a countdown from 5 to 1 using IN RANGE, then log "Liftoff!" after the loop.
